- 10m — quick intro / logistics
- 40m — technical/coding exercise (pairing)

Subject: Re: Interview confirmation — Product Engineer (tech screen) — Thu May 19 10:00 PT

Hi Jonas —

I'm sorry to do this last-minute, but I just got an automated notification from the immigration office: I need to appear for a mandatory biometrics appointment on Thu, May 19 at 09:45am. They scheduled it when I submitted forms; I can't move it through the website (only in-person reassignment at the office). I can try to request a later slot but it might not be processed in time.

Is there any flexibility? I can do:
- a recorded take-home coding exercise today/tonight and join a 30-min sync tomorrow, or
- an earlier compressed 45-min interview tomorrow or Friday morning, or
- move the full panel to next week.

Really sorry for the inconvenience — I want to be transparent because I know the panel's time is limited.

Thanks,
Ethan
+1 (650) 555-1289
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Li <ethan.li@gmail.com>, Amber Talent Partners <sarah@ambertalent.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T08:10:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Interview conflict — biometrics appointment (reschedule options)

Hi Monica + Grace —

Quick heads up: Ethan (candidate) just flagged a mandatory biometrics appointment that conflicts with Thu 10am. He proposed three options (take-home + 30m follow-up tomorrow, earlier compressed interview, or move to next week).

Panel constraints: Monica has only late afternoon slots tomorrow, Grace can do a 8:00am start tomorrow but not before. We want to avoid pushing the full loop out a week if we can keep momentum.

My proposal (in order of preference):
1) Offer a take-home coding problem to be completed within 12–24 hours + a 30-minute live sync (to go over approach) tomorrow between 11:00–14:00 PT — fastest way to evaluate without rebooking full panel.
2) If candidate prefers live, do a compressed 45-min pairing session tomorrow at 8:00am PT with Grace + one other engineer (I'll swap Monica with another hiring partner), then do a short culture sync later in the week.
3) As fallback, reschedule full panel for next week (provide 2 windows).

Ethan — can you confirm option 1 works for you? If yes I'll send the take-home link and a calendar stub for the sync.

Jonas
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Li <ethan.li@gmail.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Interview conflict — biometrics appointment (reschedule options)

Thanks for the summary. I'm fine with swapping — happy to review the take-home writeup rather than do the full pairing. If we take that route, let's ask for a 12-hour turnaround with a pipelined 30-minute debrief (recording optional).

If Ethan prefers live, I can be replaced on the live pairing by Carlos Mendoza (staff engineer) — Carlos can cover the architecture/coding portion and we'll do a culture sync later.

Monica
Hiring Manager, Product Engineering
From: Ethan Li <ethan.li@gmail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interview conflict — biometrics appointment (reschedule options)

Hi Jonas / Monica —

Thanks for the quick response and for accommodating. Option 1 (take-home + 30-min sync tomorrow) works best for me. I can complete the take-home tonight if provided and be available for a 30-minute call tomorrow between 12:00–14:00 PT.

A couple of quick asks:
- Can you confirm the expected deliverables and language (Python or JS)?
- Any time limit / runtime constraints?

Appreciate it — and sorry again for the curveball.

Best,
Ethan
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Li <ethan.li@gmail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Amber Talent Partners <sarah@ambertalent.com>

Subject: Confirmed: take-home + 30m sync tomorrow (instructions attached)

Ethan —

Thanks for confirming. Plan:
- Take-home sent now (attached PDF + Google Doc link). Complete within 12 hours (deadline: 21:20 PT tonight). Language: Python preferred but JS accepted. Deliverable: a short repo or single file with README and brief explanation of trade-offs. No external API calls; unit tests optional.
- 30-minute sync tomorrow May 19 at 12:30pm PT with Monica (or Carlos if schedule changes) to talk through approach and ask clarifying questions. Calendar stub attached.

Attachments: takehome-instructions.pdf (high-level prompt) — also here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-takehome-instructions
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=jonas-weber-panel-19may2027

If anything changes with your biometrics appointment or timing, please ping me and we'll adapt. Good luck — looking forward to seeing your solution.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
